question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A short stay at a place.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Sojourn"** means a temporary stay at a place. (अल्पकालिक प्रवास)

 
 
• **Example: **During his sojourn in Paris, he visited many art galleries and museums.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Xenophobe** (विदेशियों से घृणा करने वाला व्यक्ति): A person who has an intense or irrational dislike or fear of people from other countries.

 
 
• **Example:** The xenophobe refused to accept any foreign cultures or traditions.
 
 
 
• **Embargo** (प्रतिबंध): An official ban on trade or other commercial activity with a particular country.
 
 
• **Example: **The government has imposed an embargo on all imports from that nation.
 
 
 
• **Topiary** (झाड़ियों को काट कर सजाना): The art or practice of clipping shrubs or trees into ornamental shapes.
 
 
• **Example:** The garden featured beautiful topiary of animals and geometric shapes.
